LanguageData.MST.stuffCommonalityComment: Relative weight for random generation: affects weapons, apparel, loot and wild-building material choice. Unrelated to deep scanning commonality.
LanguageData.MST.stuffAllowedInGenerationComment: When off, this stuff is never picked by random generation (weapons, apparel, loot, wild-building materials). Manual construction is unaffected.
LanguageData.MST.stuffAirtightComment: Whether this stuff is airtight. Only matters for buildings that take airtightness from their stuff; affects indoor/outdoor temperature and vacuum separation.
LanguageData.MST.deepCommonalityComment: Commonality for deep scanning / ground-penetrating scanner.
LanguageData.MST.deepCountPerPortionComment: Yield per portion from deep drilling.
LanguageData.MST.deepCountPerCellComment: Resource count per cell from ground-penetrating scanner.
LanguageData.MST.deepLumpSizeRangeComment: Range of resource cell count after scanning (min~max).
